audit_log.value: I’m a small marketing agency owner and need a professional monthly services agreement for a client. We started with managing Instagram and email newsletters, but now they keep adding ad campaigns, website edits, weekend requests, and strategy calls without updating the budget. I want something clean and business-friendly that clearly defines the monthly retainer, what work is included, hourly rates for extra work, approval required before out-of-scope tasks begin, turnaround times, rush request fees, payment due dates, pause/termination terms, ownership of work after payment, confidentiality, and an easy process for both sides to review changes before signing.

effective_date: Upon full execution by all parties
